statement: For every nonzero apartment-code support S, the intrinsic theta graph has degree D=8(q-1), the induced support graph is D/2-regular, and every selected vertex has D/2 external neighbors.

consequences.one_step_random_walk: P(stay)=P(exit)=1/2 from the uniform distribution on S

boundary: Necessary code-support structure only; no converse and no distance proof.
